project_type: PHP + MySQL + Tailwind CSS PWA with Firebase Cloud Messaging
verification_instructions: Verify PHP files have no syntax errors via php -l. Verify JS files have no syntax errors.
setup_instructions: No build step needed. PHP files are served directly by web server.
environment_constraints: No PHP server running, no MySQL. Validation limited to syntax checking.
contribution_requirements: Keep same coding style. Use Tailwind CSS from CDN. Use same session pattern as other parent portal pages.
key_patterns: Session auth pattern: check session_status, ini_set cookie lifetime, session_start, then check $_SESSION['tutor_autenticado'] === true. Styles: bg-crema (#f7f3eb), text-vino (#5c1931), bg-vino (#5c1931), text-dorado (#a48253). Fonts: Playfair Display (serif-elegant), Plus Jakarta Sans (sans-clean). All parent pages use Tailwind CDN and same head/meta structure as padres.php.
directory_structure: Root: PHP files, app.js, sw.js. /admin: admin panel. /api: JSON endpoints. /config: service account. /sql: migrations.
